_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); hotel signals

pit_profile.why: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 3,178 properties (560,681 rooms)'; 'The lodging industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'The economic recession, the global credit crisis and eroded consumer confidence all contributed to a difficult business environment in 2008' (its own FY2008 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Marriott: 'Consistent with our focus on management and franchising, we own very few of our lodging properties'; 'We are a worldwide operator and franchisor of 3,178 properties (560,681 rooms)'; 'The lodging industry is highly competitive, which may impact our ability to compete successfully with other hotel and timeshare properties for customers'; 'The profitability of the hotels, vacation timeshare resorts, and corporate apartments that we operate or franchise may be adversely affected by a number of factors, including: ... international, national, and regional economic and geopolitical conditions'; and 'The economic recession, the global credit crisis and eroded consumer confidence all contributed to a difficult business environment in 2008' (its own FY2008 10-K): a hotel management and franchise system whose fees follow the revenues and profits of its hotels through the economy, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +93% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.27; conservative 2yr -34%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -45.8%/yr (worst year FY99-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-17.3%/yr (Q4 fee guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.1%/yr (FY99-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +31.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MAR (retrospective, 2010-01-08) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (85.7% downside to Bear $4 / +-10.8% upside to Bull $25) | Adj composite 1.25 vs market 3.52: gap -2.27 [OVERVALUED] | +93% above the EPP floor $15 (18x FY09E $0.81) | Conservative 2-yr case: -33.8% total (-16.9%/yr) | At 34.8x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $37 sits above the BULL case; North American RevPAR -20.6% in Q3 2009, forward fee revenue -22.89% to -20.4% (Q4 2009 fee revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
